title: Senior Backend Engineer (PHP)
descriptionHtml:
Northwind Labs builds billing tools for small clinics.

You will own the invoicing service, written in PHP 8 and Laravel, and the queue workers behind it.

  • Five years of backend work
  • PostgreSQL and Redis in production
  • Comfortable with on-call once a month

title: Frontend Developer, Vue
descriptionHtml:
Harbor & Pine runs a booking site for ferry lines.

The frontend is Vue 3 with TypeScript; you will rebuild the seat map and the checkout, and keep both fast on a phone on a boat.

We work in English, four days a week in Hamburg or fully remote inside the EU.
